类 ShapedRecipe

public class ShapedRecipe extends CraftingRecipe
代表一个有序（即普通的）合成配方。

原文： Represents a shaped (ie normal) crafting recipe.

    • ShapedRecipe

      public ShapedRecipe(@NotNull @NotNull NamespacedKey key, @NotNull @NotNull ItemStack result)
      创建一个合成指定物品的配方。构造函数仅决定结果和类型；要设置实际配方，你需要调用适当的方法。

      原文： Create a shaped recipe to craft the specified ItemStack. The constructor merely determines the result and type; to set the actual recipe, you'll need to call the appropriate methods.

      参数:
      key - 配方的唯一键。

      原文：the unique recipe key

      result - 你希望配方创建的物品。

      原文：The item you want the recipe to create.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果 result 是空物品（AIR）。

      原文：if the result is an empty item (AIR)

      另请参阅:
      • shape(String...)
      • setIngredient(char, Material)
      • setIngredient(char, RecipeChoice)

  • 方法详细资料

    • shape

      @NotNull public @NotNull ShapedRecipe shape(@NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String... shape)
      设置此配方的形状为指定的行。每个字符代表不同的成分；空格字符必须为空，每个字符代表什么需要单独设置。第一行对应工作台最上方的部分，例如如果提供三行，第一行代表工作台最上面一行。

      原文： Set the shape of this recipe to the specified rows. Each character represents a different ingredient; excluding space characters, which must be empty, exactly what each character represents is set separately. The first row supplied corresponds with the upper most part of the recipe on the workbench e.g. if all three rows are supplies the first string represents the top row on the workbench.

      参数:
      shape - 配方的行（最多3行）。

      原文：The rows of the recipe (up to 3 rows).

      返回:
      修改后的配方，以便链式调用。

      原文：Set the shape of this recipe to the specified rows. Each character represents a different ingredient; excluding space characters, which must be empty, exactly what each character represents is set separately. The first row supplied corresponds with the upper most part of the recipe on the workbench e.g. if all three rows are supplies the first string represents the top row on the workbench.

      原文：The changed recipe, so you can chain calls.

      @NotNull @Deprecated public @NotNull ShapedRecipe setIngredient(char key, @NotNull @NotNull MaterialData ingredient)
      已过时。
      use setIngredient(char, RecipeChoice)
      设置配方形状中某个字符引用的 RecipeChoice。注意，在设置成分之前，必须先使用 shape(String...) 定义配方的形状。

      原文： Sets the material that a character in the recipe shape refers to.

      Note that before an ingredient can be set, the recipe's shape must be defined with shape(String...).

      参数:
      key - 形状中代表成分的字符。

      原文：The character that represents the ingredient in the shape.

      ingredient - 成分。

      原文：The ingredient.

      返回:
      修改后的配方，以便链式调用。

      原文：The changed recipe, so you can chain calls.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果 key 是空格字符。

      原文：if the key is a space character

      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果 key 是空格字符。

      原文：if the key does not appear in the shape.
